question:
The figure shown can be folded into the shape of a cube. In the resulting cube, which of the lettered faces is opposite the face marked \(x?\)

[Figure 1](figures/1995_AMC_12_Q06_question_fig1.svg)
solution:
Keep face \(A\) as the front of the cube. Tracking its neighboring faces first makes the fold easier to follow.

[Figure 1](figures/1995_AMC_12_Q06_question_fig1.svg)

Face \(x\), attached to the left edge of \(A\), folds into the left face. Face \(B\), attached above \(A\), folds into the top face. The shared edge between \(B\) and \(C\) is then the right edge of that top face, so \(C\) folds down to become the right face.

The left and right faces are opposite. Therefore the face opposite \(x\) is \(\boxed{C}\), choice \(\text{C}\).
